sections.heading: Connect your AI
sections.body: Pick the AI you use. Once it is connected, it does the rest of the setup itself.

tabs.label: Grok
tabs.lead: Open your AI chat and paste the prepared connection message there. This connects Trillion to that AI.

copy.text: Set up Trillion in the AI app where we are having this conversation. Use https://app.example/mcp. Identify this app and configure its MCP connection yourself with OAuth where supported; otherwise guide only the necessary settings actions. Keep sign-in running while I authorize. If it times out, start a fresh login and use its new Trillion sign-in link. Never ask for my password, API key or callback URL. Once connected, call start_setup immediately and follow its saved workflow. Do every authorized setup action, including applicable hooks, ongoing work, devices, accounts and initial data. Reuse what you know about me; ask only for an unknown fact or device action you cannot perform. Verify the useful result with read_setup. Do not stop at listing tools or giving me a manual.

copy.text: Connect Trillion to Claude Code on this computer. Run this line yourself: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user trillion https://app.example/mcp && claude mcp login trillion. Keep it running while I sign in on the Trillion page it opens, then run claude mcp list to check it says Connected and verify the MCP connection. After the connection works, call start_setup immediately and continue its saved workflow. Do not stop at confirming the MCP connection. Complete the machine-doable work now, show only necessary human actions, and read_setup again to check the actual result.
